descriptionRu: Расскажи о героях и сюжете. Посоветуй фильм и объясни, почему он тебе нравится.
descriptionKk: Өзіңе ұнайтын фильм туралы айтып бер.
opening: Hi! Let's talk about films. I'll ask you a few questions, and you can ask me for help at any time.

firstQuestions.A2: What is a film you really like?
firstQuestions.B1: Which film would you recommend, and what do you like about it?
firstQuestions.B2: Which film has stayed with you, and what makes it worth recommending?

questions: What is a film you really like?
What do you like about the main character?
What is your favourite part of the film?
Why did you enjoy that part?
How is it different from other films you know?
Who would enjoy watching this film?
Would you watch it again? Why?
How would you recommend this film in one sentence?

descriptionRu: Придумай идеальный праздник: занятия, игры и то, чего ждёшь больше всего.
opening: Hi! Let's imagine a holiday together. I'll help you make a plan, one question at a time.

firstQuestions.A2: What would you like to do for New Year or another holiday?
firstQuestions.B1: Choose a holiday. What are you planning to do, and why?
firstQuestions.B2: What would your ideal holiday celebration look like, and how would you organise it?

questions: What would you like to do for New Year or another holiday?
What are you going to do first?
Which activity are you looking forward to?
Why would you choose that activity?
What game could you play?
What could you do if the weather changes?
What would make this holiday special?
How would you describe your plan in one sentence?

descriptionRu: Поделись маленькой историей: что было сначала, что потом и что запомнилось.
opening: Hi! Let's talk about your weekend. You can tell me a real story or make one up. I'll start with a question.

firstQuestions.A2: What did you do last weekend? You can tell a real or imaginary story.
firstQuestions.B1: Tell me about your weekend. What happened first?
firstQuestions.B2: What made your last real or imaginary weekend memorable?

questions: What did you do last weekend? You can tell a real or imaginary story.
What did you watch?
What did you enjoy most about it?
What happened after that?
How did you feel about your day?
Was it different from your usual weekend?
What would you like to do again?
What was the best part of your weekend?

descriptionRu: Выбери номер в вымышленном отеле. Спроси о цене, завтраке и удобствах.
opening: Hello! I'm the receptionist in our imaginary hotel. Let's practise choosing a room together.

firstQuestions.A2: Welcome to our imaginary hotel. What kind of room would you like?
firstQuestions.B1: Welcome to Maple Hotel. What room would you like for your imaginary trip?
firstQuestions.B2: Welcome to Maple Hotel. How can I help you choose a room for this role-play?

questions: Welcome to our imaginary hotel. What kind of room would you like?
For how many imaginary nights would you like to stay?
A double room is £60 per night. What would you like to ask about it?
Breakfast is £5 per person. Would you like to include it?
What else would you like to know about the room?
Would you prefer a different type of room?
Could you confirm your room and number of nights?
Thank you! What did you choose in our role-play?

descriptionRu: Найди нужную вещь, уточни цвет или размер и выбери подходящий вариант.
descriptionKk: Оқу дүкенінен өзіңе ұнайтын затты таңда.
opening: Hello! I'm the shop assistant in our imaginary shop. Let's find something you like together.

firstQuestions.A2: Hello! Would you like a T-shirt, a notebook or a backpack?
firstQuestions.B1: Welcome to our imaginary shop. What are you looking for today?
firstQuestions.B2: Welcome! What would you like to find in our shop, and what matters most to you?

questions: Hello! Would you like a T-shirt, a notebook or a backpack?
Which colour would you like?
What would you like to know about the item?
The T-shirt is £15. Would you like to try a different option?
Would you like to compare it with another item?
Is there anything else you would like to ask?
Which option would you choose?
How would you politely finish this conversation?
